description.en: Turns any 3D model, SVG, or image into floating liquid glass with real refraction, dispersion, and frost.
description.zh: 将任意 3D 模型、SVG 或图片变为悬浮液态玻璃，呈现真实折射、色散与磨砂效果。

discovery.caveat: 需准备目标模型、SVG 或图片；渲染器要求见详情。

notice.en: Reference entry. This AI catalog does not redistribute component source. Install directly from the author's registry under its license; the @canvas-ui namespace belongs to the upstream author.
notice.zh: 来源收藏条目。本 AI 目录不重新分发组件源码；如需使用，请遵守作者许可并直接从作者的注册表安装。@canvas-ui 属于上游作者。

description.en: URL of the asset: GLB/glTF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Object URLs from a file input work too. The format is detected from the bytes, not the extension. SVGs and images are traced and extruded into a rounded glass slab; models keep their geometry. Draco-compressed models are supported via a decoder fetched on demand.
description.zh: 素材 URL：GLB/glTF、SVG、PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF；也支持文件输入产生的 Object URL。根据字节内容识别格式，而非扩展名。SVG 与图片会描摹并拉伸为圆润玻璃板，模型保留自身几何。按需下载解码器以支持 Draco 压缩模型。

description.en: Index of refraction of the glass (1 to 2.33).
description.zh: 玻璃折射率（1 至 2.33）。

description.en: Thickness of the glass volume in scene units. Drives how strongly light bends.
description.zh: 玻璃体积厚度，单位为场景单位，决定光线弯折的强度。

description.en: Surface roughness (0 to 1). Higher values frost the glass.
description.zh: 表面粗糙度（0 至 1），值越高玻璃越磨砂。

description.en: Chromatic dispersion of the refraction (0 to 2). Splits light into rainbow fringes like real glass.
description.zh: 折射的色散程度（0 至 2），像真实玻璃一样把光分成彩虹边缘。

description.en: Clearcoat layer on top of the glass (0 to 1).
description.zh: 玻璃表面的清漆层强度（0 至 1）。

description.en: Tint color of the glass volume as any CSS color. Leave empty to keep the glass clear.
description.zh: 玻璃体积的着色，可使用任意 CSS 颜色；留空保持透明。

description.en: How strongly the tint absorbs light through the volume.
description.zh: 着色吸收穿过体积光线的强度。

description.en: Extrusion depth of 2D assets (SVG or image) as a fraction of their longest side.
description.zh: 二维素材（SVG 或图片）的拉伸深度，相对于其最长边。

description.en: Edge rounding of extruded 2D assets (0 to 1). Higher values melt the edges into a liquid lip.
description.zh: 拉伸二维素材的边缘圆润程度（0 至 1）；较高值使边缘呈液态唇口。

description.en: Accent color of the ring light in the studio environment.
description.zh: 工作室环境中环形灯的强调色。

description.en: Brightness of the studio environment lighting.
description.zh: 工作室环境光亮度。

description.en: Background color behind the glass. Leave empty for a transparent canvas; an opaque color shows through the refraction.
description.zh: 玻璃后方的背景颜色。留空则画布透明；不透明颜色会透过折射显示。

description.en: URL of an image shown as a backdrop behind the glass, cover-fit to the view. The glass samples and refracts it. Leave empty to disable.
description.zh: 玻璃后方的背景图 URL，以 cover 方式填满视图。玻璃会采样并折射它；留空关闭。

description.en: Size of the longest side of the asset in scene units. The camera sits about 4 units away.
description.zh: 素材最长边的大小，单位为场景单位；摄像机距离约为 4 个单位。

description.en: Horizontal offset of the asset in scene units.
description.zh: 素材的水平偏移，单位为场景单位。

description.en: Vertical offset of the asset in scene units.
description.zh: 素材的垂直偏移，单位为场景单位。

description.en: Strength of the floating bob animation (0 disables).
description.zh: 上下漂浮动画的强度（0 关闭）。

description.en: Strength of the idle rocking rotation (0 disables).
description.zh: 闲置摇摆旋转的强度（0 关闭）。

description.en: Speed of the float and rocking animation.
description.zh: 漂浮与摇摆动画的速度。

description.en: Let the user orbit the camera by dragging.
description.zh: 允许用户拖动以环绕观察物体。

description.en: Let the user zoom with the scroll wheel or pinch.
description.zh: 允许用户使用滚轮或双指手势缩放。

description.en: Spin the camera around the asset turntable-style.
description.zh: 让摄像机以转台方式环绕素材。

description.en: Turntable speed when autoRotate is on.
description.zh: autoRotate 开启时的转台速度。

description.en: Camera field of view in degrees.
description.zh: 相机视场角，单位为度。

description.en: Camera distance from the center of the asset.
description.zh: 摄像机与素材中心的距离。

description.en: Base URL of the Draco decoder, fetched only when a model needs it.
description.zh: Draco 解码器的基础网址，仅在模型需要时加载。

description.en: Called after an asset finishes loading.
description.zh: 素材加载完成后调用。

description.en: Called when an asset fails to load.
description.zh: 素材加载失败时调用。

description.en: Classes applied to the wrapper element.
description.zh: 应用到包装元素的 CSS 类。

dependencies.frameworkNote: Solid uses solid-js; Preact uses preact. Other framework dependencies follow the target project.

install.behavior: Commands are metadata only. This catalog and CLI never execute installation.

browserNotes: WebGPU builds need a browser with WebGPU; verify the current browser support before choosing a renderer.
HTML-in-Canvas is experimental. Check the component's current upstream browser/fallback documentation. Do not assume DOM capture works in every browser.
